title: The Schur multiplier of $\rm{SL}_2$ and Dedekind zeta-functions over $S$-integers
summary: In this paper, we obtain an exact sequence connecting $H_2(\rm{SL}_2(\mathcal{O}_{K,S}), \mathbb{Z})$ to $H_2(\rm{SL}_2(\mathcal{O}_{K,T}), \mathbb{Z})$, where $\mathcal{O}_{K,S}$ is a ring of $S$-integers and $T$ is a set of primes containing $S$. We apply this sequence to establish a relation between $H_2(\rm{SL}_2(\mathcal{O}_{K,S}), \mathbb{Z})$ with the second $K$-group $K_2(\mathcal{O}_{K,S})$, for $S$ large enough.
